marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech Sector & AI Infrastructure Investment
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed technology conglomerates reported increased capital expenditure in Q2 dedicated to domestic cloud data centers and proprietary large language model integration.
marketLayer.inference: Near-term operating margins may experience temporary compression due to heavy CapEx, but long-term enterprise software monetization potential improves for market leaders.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persistent semiconductor supply constraints and the commercial conversion speed of generative AI applications.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Rate Path & Mega-Cap Tech Valuations
marketLayer.fact: US equity markets traded sideways during Asian hours as resilient labor and core inflation data lowered market consensus for aggressive Fed rate cuts in H2.
marketLayer.inference: Elevated Treasury yields may trigger short-term valuation consolidation across high-multiple US growth stocks, prompting temporary sector rotation into cash-generative defensives.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Upcoming FOMC policy statement tone and Q2 mega-cap tech earnings guidance.

marketLayer.title: HK-Listed EV Manufacturers & Price Competition
marketLayer.fact: Several HK-listed Chinese electric vehicle OEMs introduced revamped mid-tier models with upgraded autonomous driving capabilities at competitive price points.
marketLayer.inference: Price competition will maintain pressure on gross margins across the sector, accelerating market share consolidation toward vertically integrated industry leaders.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolution of international trade tariffs and domestic consumer spending sentiment in lower-tier markets.
